why: Veer, 27 Oct: for something expensive, a budget version is a useful option, unless they love it (the luxury, the people there). Offered once, never for therapy, clinical care or anything from a clinician.

rows.premium-gym-membership-equinox-life-time: A standard gym with the equipment you use, plus a class pass for the days you want the extras.
rows.personal-trainer: A session every other week to check your form, with the program on your own between.
rows.boutique-class-membership-barry-s-soulcy: A class pack for your favourite days, with runs or home workouts between.
rows.yoga-pilates-studio: A class pack for one or two favourite classes a week, and a mat at home between.
rows.recovery-studio-membership-restore-remed: A pay-per-visit pass for the sauna and plunge you actually use.
rows.stretch-studio-assisted-stretching: One assisted session a month, with a 10-minute stretch at home between.
rows.massage-monthly: A massage every other month, with a massage ball for sore spots between.
rows.meal-delivery-or-meal-prep-service: A smaller plan for your busiest nights, with a simple Sunday cook for the rest.
rows.sauna-bathhouse-membership: A gym that has a sauna, or a day pass on the weeks you want it.
rows.eight-sleep-cooling-mattress-pad: A fan, lighter bedding and a cooler room do much of the same.
rows.facials-monthly: A facial each season, with a simple routine at home between.
